backlogged.summary: In lib/verify.mjs the new outer `const cacheFile` (verify result cache) is shadowed by the existing inner `const cacheFile` (test-count cache) inside the test_count block. It works because the scopes differ, but the two cache files with one name are easy to confuse. Rename one of them.

A cache hit returns `[...stored.warnings, ...warnings]`. Warnings that are stored with a pass (e.g. 'verify.test_paths is empty') are repeated on every hit, so a hit result may show warnings that describe a past run rather than this one.
